summary.text: Ruslan Shamal is a Staten Island broadcaster and small-business owner running as the Republican/Conservative nominee. Born in Belarus, he has lived on Staten Island since 2014, has worked in broadcast media for more than 20 years, and ran unsuccessfully for New York City Council District 49 in 2023. According to a September 2026 news report, his campaign focuses on public safety, bail law changes, and opposing tax increases.

paragraphs.text: Emigrated from Belarus; lived in Brooklyn and Massachusetts before settling on Staten Island in 2014.
Has worked in broadcast media for more than 20 years and runs an e-commerce business; the report describing his candidacy calls him a radio host.
Opened FurStar Resort, a dog daycare business in Staten Island's Tompkinsville neighborhood.
Ran for New York City Council District 49 in 2023 on the Safe Streets SI Party line, finishing second to incumbent Kamillah Hanks (16.4% to 79.2%).
Advanced as the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for State Senate District 23 on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

sources.title: He Escaped Belarus. Now, Radio Host Is Running for Office on Staten Island to Fight Socialism
